meta.prompt_suffix: SCREEN RULE: any phone or monitor screen in this frame is a light source, not a dark slab — a bright, near-white interface that is the brightest rectangle in the picture, never switched off, never a black screen, never showing a blinking cursor bar. LETTERING RULE: only the surfaces that were given a quoted phrase above carry any lettering at all. Every other badge, ribbon, medal, signboard, poster, notice, sheet of paper, book spine, box, label and screen in the frame is completely BLANK — clean unmarked material with no characters on it. A blank surface is a correct result; an invented or half-formed word is a failure. NUMBER RULE, applies to every number in this image: each amount is drawn exactly as quoted above, in the short Korean unit form, and always sits on ONE unbroken line. Never wrap a number onto a second line, never split it in the middle of a digit group, never let a comma fall at the end of a line. If an amount would not fit across the surface it sits on, draw the amount smaller — never break it. Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles, brand-free shopping and office props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one person, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression; many scenes have only one. Render only the Korean words quoted above; every other surface stays free of lettering. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark. Do not invent any other lettering anywhere in the image — no English text beyond the English line quoted above, no latin letters, no fake Chinese characters, no gibberish text, no random lettering, no invented words. No brand logos, no company names, no stock ticker names anywhere.

The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the deeply shadowed foreground ground and the dark bases of the objects nearest the viewer, so dark and so free of detail that it reads as one single dark mass, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no panel, no number and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign, badge and number sits in the upper five-eighths. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden backlight, and is crowded with things to look at.
